title: Slovenia's Budget Balancing Act: Growth Ambitions Meet Fiscal and Inflation… · 22 Oct
keywords: Slovenia, budget 2027, fiscal policy, EU deficit rules, economic growth, inflation, cost of living, energy costs, public spending, trade unions, Stability and Growth Pact, Ljubljana, euro area, EU funds, development investment
notes: Slovenia's new government is pressing ahead with a development-oriented budget for 2027–28, pledging to keep the deficit below the European Union's 3% threshold while funding infrastructure, digitalisation and municipal investment. The plan arrives as the country records stronger-than-expected economic growth but continues to wrestle with inflation running well above the European Central Bank's target. Whether Ljubljana can deliver investment without sacrificing service quality or household purchasing power is the central question shaping Slovenia's near-term political and economic debate.
